description: Reverse Engineer Anything - MCP server and CLI for agent-driven reverse engineering
notes: Requires Node.js ^22.19 || ^24.11 || >=26 (either suggested nodejs package works).
First-time setup (once per machine) - interactive, multi-agent:
Pick the agents to register (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, ...),
review the plan, approve; restart the agents afterwards.
After scoop update: skill is version-locked to the server, refresh it:
MCP registration points at the scoop shim, so it needs no change on update.
